description: Drive Timeline's transport: play, pause, stop, seek to a time, or step one frame. Seeking applies the interpolation immediately, so pairing a seek with studio_screenshot is how you look at a given moment of the animation — take the screenshot in its own call, not in the same batch, since the frame it captures is the one before. 'stop' rewinds to 0 and applies that pose. Steps use the frame rate from studio_timeline_set_settings. Requires the Timeline plugin (check 'available' in studio_timeline_get_state).

action.description: 'play' is idempotent here — it never toggles back to pause, unlike Timeline's own button

time.description: seconds, required by 'seek'; must be between 0 and the timeline duration

output.description: same shape as studio_timeline_get_state, interpolables listed without their keyframes
